summary: Frontend dev proxy target configurable (ANVIL_API_PROXY), so a second API port can be used
description:
[claude] `frontend/vite.config.ts` hard-codes the `/api` proxy target to `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. With several APIs on one machine (per-agent ports, e.g. claude's offline API on :8010 on 11-05) the UI can't be pointed at the other port without editing a tracked file.

**Change:** `'/api': process.env.ANVIL_API_PROXY ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:8000'`, plus one line in SETUP.md.

**Acceptance:**

* `npm test` unchanged (it uses relative `/api`).
* `ANVIL_API_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:8010 npx vite` reaches the :8010 API (verified 11-05: /api/sessions answered 200).
